article.headline: Games To Watch: Lewisburg brings unbeaten soccer teams to Center Hill
article.html:
Lewisburg puts two unbeaten soccer starts on the line at Center Hill on Thursday, November 12. The girls open at 5 p.m. Central, with the boys following at 7 p.m., giving the Patriots two road tests against hosts who also carry winning records. On the basketball court, South Panola and Walnut each enter a 6 p.m. girls game at 3-0. Their visitors arrive in different positions: Hernando is looking for its first listed win, while Corinth brings a 1-1 record.

Soccer: Lewisburg takes its winning starts to Center Hill

The girls matchup in Olive Branch pairs Lewisburg’s listed 3-0 record with Center Hill’s 2-1 mark. The 5 p.m. start offers Lewisburg a chance to add another win away from home while Center Hill can halt the visitors’ unbeaten opening. The non-district meeting brings together teams that have each won more often than they have lost.

The boys take over at 7 p.m. with Lewisburg listed at 2-0 and Center Hill at 3-1. Center Hill has more wins on the current matchup listing, while Lewisburg has yet to take a loss. The Patriots can leave with their unbeaten mark intact only by adding a road result against a side that already has three wins. Like the girls opener, this is a non-district match.

Girls basketball: unbeaten hosts face different challenges

In Batesville, South Panola hosts Hernando at 6 p.m. The current listing has South Panola at 3-0 and Hernando at 0-3. South Panola can extend its perfect start to four wins; Hernando has the opportunity to break through against an opponent that has not yet lost. The non-district meeting puts South Panola’s winning run against Hernando’s search for a breakthrough.

Farther north, Walnut welcomes Corinth at 6 p.m. with another unbeaten start to protect on its home floor. Walnut is listed at 3-0 and Corinth at 1-1, making this a chance for the Wildcats to keep their opening run intact or for the Warriors to move to a winning record. The game is non-district.

For broader recent coverage of some of these schools, our November 10 scores roundup includes boys basketball involving Center Hill, Hernando and Walnut.
